description: The Queen: three acts — one blade, two blades, and the halo coming apart.
notes: The same floor, start and spawn as `first_blade`, `captain` and `thorn_marshal`, so the one thing that differs between the boss rooms is the boss. A body whose whole claim is tempo has to be measured on a floor the other tempos were measured on.

Three acts on HP thresholds: REGALIA to 50%, UNSWORN to 25%, LAST DECREE below it. Each is a phrase pair, alternating on a counted parity, with no RNG anywhere in the fight — the speed is the difficulty and a die on top of it would make a read into a reaction test.
180s rather than the boss rooms' 120s. Three acts at 880 HP is a longer fight than a two-phase boss, and a time limit that ends it mid-third-act would report a loss that was a clock.

Public since 2026-08-03 (ADR-037), which reverses ADR-032 clause 1: the herald offers her as an aside, `game/public-profile.ts` carries her tuning field for field and `cast/index-public.ts` her body. She is still an instrument — being reachable is not the same as having been played, and ADR-005's gate stands.
